analyst.summary: The milestone supports a review of newly matured evidence, not a claim of learned market skill. Prospective tests have both supportive and negative lifecycle classifications, but supplied evidence does not establish incremental value over baselines or independent replication. The highest-information bounded question is whether a preregistered BTC swap mark-price RANGE test retains incremental out-of-sample value after duplicate removal, controls and regime checks. All hypotheses remain research-only; no forecast candidate is issued.
